title: Unprecedented drop in French students' performance echoes worldwide decline
subhead: Reading and maths scores for 15-year-olds in France have fallen to their lowest levels since 2000, mirroring trends seen in comparable countries. Among the reasons cited to explain this global phenomenon are attitudes toward learning, the role of digital technology, the lasting effects of the Covid-19 crisis and a lack of parental involvement. In France, significant social and gender inequalities persist.

title: Mistral AI raises €3 billion in response to doubts over its strategic direction
subhead: The French artificial intelligence start-up, accused by some experts of having abandoned the race against its American and Chinese rivals to focus on data centers and services, insists it has not given up on producing cutting-edge models. It has secured its largest-ever funding round and welcomed Samsung as a shareholder.

title: Thousands of 'Greater Serbia' supporters attend funeral of Ratko Mladic in Belgrade
subhead: The former commander of the Serbian army in Bosnia and Herzegovina, who was convicted by an international court for genocide, war crimes and crimes against humanity during the conflicts in the former Yugoslavia in the 1990s and who died in prison in The Hague, was buried in the Serbian capital on Monday.

In this French city, social diversity in schools has almost disappeared
subhead: According to studies, the southern city of Perpignan is the most educationally segregated in France. It's divided between private schools, which rank among the most privileged in the country, and public schools, which, in almost every case, sit at the exact opposite end of the social scale.

title: The end of a lawless paradise? Local government seeks to take back control of Corsican islet
subhead: Cavallo, a little gem of the Lavezzi archipelago, has always sparked envy. Once the scene of wild parties, it drew the international jet set before becoming a target for nationalists and organized crime groups. In June, the local government launched an offensive to regain control of the port and open the island up to tourists.

title: In Los Angeles, thousands of Americans are forced to live in their cars
subhead: Several thousand people live in a car, van or camper in the city of Los Angeles. The situation highlights the growing difficulties of low-income Americans to find stable housing, a major problem in the United States.
